messages:
mike-ml: heads up — onboarding Quail-14B today. license text says 'non-commercial redistribution prohibited; attribution required; weights not to be redistributed in binary form' — wanting to confirm allowed serving modes. :thinking:

emily-legal: can you paste the exact clause? sometimes the phrasing matters (e.g. 'redistribute' vs 'sublicense').

mike-ml: excerpt: "The Model weights and binaries may not be redistributed for commercial or non-commercial purposes. Derived embeddings and model outputs may be used in accordance with normal API-based usage provided attribution is given."

emily-legal: ok that reads like: hosting a hosted API is fine; we cannot ship or publish quantized/binary weights. embeddings/exported vectors are probably ok to serve to customers, but check attribution chain. Also watch for dataset-origin clauses — if any training data has extra restrictions, that impacts embeddings storage/retention.

tara-ops: so for Dedicated/Private, does that mean we can't provide a downloadable container with the weights to the customer? that's a blocker for Private deployment customers.

emily-legal: correct — Private deployment that transfers full weights to the customer likely violates the "no redistribution" term. You could provide a customer-managed runtime where we deploy into their VPC without transferring weights (managed deploy), but for on-prem physical transfer we'd need explicit permission.

sam-research: and quantization? often the vendor is ambiguous about transformed/derived weights (e.g. 4-bit quant). do we treat quantized blobs as redistribution?

emily-legal: good question. legally, quantized weights are still a derivative/binary form. Unless license carves out 'transformed weights allowed', assume it's prohibited. Request clarification from the vendor.

ci-bot: NOTE: created ticket INF-7245 to request clarification from QuailAI on redistribution of quantized or otherwise transformed weights. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7245

mike-ml: for immediate work: plan is to (1) block packaging of any downloadable weights in onboarding scripts, (2) allow hosted API + embeddings export, (3) add attribution text in UI and API responses. sample config I pushed to the onboarding repo: 
```
serving:
  allowed_operations: ["hosted_api", "embeddings"]
  redistribute_weights: false
  attribution_text: "Model: Quail-14B (QuailAI) — use subject to license; attribution required"
```

tara-ops: looks good. I'll add a gating check in the infra pipeline to fail builds that attempt to bundle weights. also will add a warning when team selects Private deploy: "Requires vendor permission to transfer weights".

emily-legal: please also add a flag in the model metadata sheet: `redistribution_allowed: yes/no/unknown` and mark Quail as `no` until we hear back. we should include the full license text in the onboarding artifact so legal can review updates later.

sam-research: one more: should we allow customers to download embeddings as files (csv/npz)? the license says outputs are ok but some dataset TOUs restrict exporting vectors derived from CC-SA content. need to surface that in the eval.

emily-legal: err on the side of caution — allow per-customer API exports but add a checkbox acceptance in the contract for any batch export. for now treat large-scale vector export as 'requires legal review'.

mike-ml: thanks — I'll update the onboarding PR with metadata flags and the packaging block. tagging @emily-legal and @tara-ops for final review. :thumbsup:

emily-legal: thx. I'll comment on INF-7245 with the questions about quantized derivatives and Private-transfer exceptions.

tara-ops: will follow up once gating check is in.

ci-bot: INF-7245 status changed to Waiting for vendor (QuailAI).
